text:
Maya: Drafting a one-page scoring rubric for the 'Ownership' competency to attach to manager calibration packets. Goal: give anchors (level 1-5) with one-line example evidence each so managers don't have to guess. Posting draft here for quick sanity check.

Ravi: Love this. Can you show both behavioral anchor + a clear artifact example? Managers like concrete callouts, e.g., PR link or calendar invite.

Maya: Yep. Draft (super compact):
Level 1 - Observed: Rarely volunteers; waits for direction. Example: Assigned tasks completed late; no proactive blockers noted.
Level 2 - Emerging: Completes work reliably; asks for clarification. Example: PRs merged on time; required frequent design check-ins.
Level 3 - Competent: Anticipates issues and informs stakeholders. Example: Opened ticket linking regression test and mitigation plan before rollout.
Level 4 - Strong: Owns end-to-end outcomes; removes cross-team blockers. Example: Led postmortem, coordinated partner fixes, metric restored.
Level 5 - Exceptional: Creates new processes that scale team output. Example: Designed release playbook adopted by 3 teams; reduced incidents by 40%.

Clara: These read well. Suggest adding a one-line guidance for calibration: "Score the observed impact on customer or team outcomes, not effort." Keeps managers aligned.

Maya: Added that line. Also adding micro-prompts to help write the "artifact" line:
- "Link one concrete artifact (PR, meeting notes, postmortem) that shows the behavior."
- "If metric-driven, add before->after value (e.g., 95% -> 99%)."

Eli: Tiny tweak: for Level 2 example swap 'frequent design check-ins' -> 'regular clarification requests' (less product-specific). Also can we add an optional "Suggested calibration tag" like #conservative or #generous for managers who want a quick nudge?

Maya: Done on both. New draft includes optional tag guidance: #conservative (lean lower when evidence is weak) vs #generous (lean higher for growth signals).

People Ops Bot: Note: Calibration workshop scheduled 2024-07-10 14:00. Packet will include this rubric and a 5-min walkthrough video.

Ravi: This will help standardize scores across managers. One ask: can we make the doc downloadable as a single-slide PDF? Managers prefer one-sheet.

Maya: I'll export to PDF and upload to the manager toolkit. Thanks for the rapid feedback — will push final by EOD.
